kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تثاءبت (form VI)
# تَثَاءَبْتُ (taṯāʔabtu) /ta.θaː.ʔab.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَثَاءَبَ (taṯāʔaba)
# تَثَاءَبْتَ (taṯāʔabta) /ta.θaː.ʔab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَثَاءَبَ (taṯāʔaba)
# تَثَاءَبْتِ (taṯāʔabti) /ta.θaː.ʔab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَثَاءَبَ (taṯāʔaba)
# تَثَاءَبَتْ (taṯāʔabat) /ta.θaː.ʔa.bat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
